title: Utility & Service Deep Dive
summary:
*   City leaders dedicated over six hours to a special meeting focused on essential city operations and infrastructure.
*   They heard detailed reports and held discussions with the Water and Wastewater Department regarding crucial utility services.
*   Operations and plans from the Electric Department were also a key topic of discussion during the lengthy session.
*   The Transportation and Public Service Department provided updates and engaged in discussions about city mobility and services.
*   This meeting served as an informational review session, with no specific policy votes or public hearings recorded.
